verdict.rationale: SharePoint documents REST and Microsoft Graph APIs for automation. These include read-write access to tenant-level SharePointSettings, which covers the admin-endpoint part of the story. Beyond that, the evidence only shows CRUD on files, folders, lists and list items, with nothing on users, members or groups. Missing for 10: documented member/user provisioning endpoints, group/permission management APIs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of admin automation.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the team is manageable by API — member provisioning, group management, and admin endpoints documented for automation

citations.quote: Now, developers can interact remotely with SharePoint data by using any technology that supports REST web requests.
Use **PUT** and **MERGE** operations to update existing SharePoint objects.
